name: Shenzhen Mason Technologies Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Mason Technologies Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the LED packaging and lighting business in China and internationally. It operates through New Generation Information Technology, Energy, and Advertising Media segments. The company offers surface mount technology (SMD) products, through-hole products (LAMP), infrared transmitter/receiver modules (IRM), and medium-to-large-size backlight products for use in consumer electronics, TV backlighting, fire protection and security, automotive electronics, and smart home fields; LED lighting products, including tri-proof lights, street lights, industrial and mining lights, panel lights, tubes and advertising signage modul…
